question: A tower is topped by a hemispherical dome that has a surface area of 363π sq.ft approximately. Find the volume of the dome (in cubic ft).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area of the dome (3πr²) = 363π sq.ft.

r² = 363 / 3 = 121 ⇒ r = 11 ft.

Volume of the dome = (2/3)πr³ = (2/3) × π × 11³.

Volume = (2/3) × 1331 × π = 887.33π ≈ 887.3π cubic ft.

**∴ The correct answer is 887.3π cubic ft.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface area of the hemispherical dome = 363π sq.ft.

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere = 3πr²

Volume of Hemisphere = (2/3)πr³

 
 

 
•

**Calculations:**

⇒ r² = 363 / 3

⇒ r² = 121

⇒ r = √121 = 11 ft

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × π × (11)³

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × π × 1331

⇒ Volume = 2662π / 3

⇒ Volume ≈ 887.33π cubic ft

**∴ The correct answer is 887.3π cubic ft.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

A sphere has a total surface area of 4πr² and a volume of (4/3)πr³.

Hemisphere Variations

Curved Surface Area (CSA) is 2πr², while Total Surface Area (TSA) including the base is 3πr².

Volume Relationship

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half the volume of a sphere with the same radius: V = (2/3)πr³.
